name: DeepGEMM independent 1CTA/2CTA cluster_sm set derived from deepgemm_100
notes: Not the archived manifests/deepgemm_single_sm.json or deepgemm_dual_sm.json inventories
uses_cluster comes from H100 full-GPU topology.cluster_cta_counts / multicast
cluster cases request one 2CTA cluster via set_num_sms(2) (even, vendor-legal)
non-cluster cases prefer set_num_sms(1) when the kernel does not construct GemmDesc
GemmDesc even-SM assert kept; non-cluster GemmDesc cases use legal num_sms=2 as two ordinary CTAs (not cluster/multicast)
bf16/fp8 k-grouped skew cases keep the source non-cluster mechanism by requesting num_groups>4, the only vendor-heuristic condition that disables KGrouped multicast at num_sms=2
